description: This file implements a service class `DuplicateDetector` for detecting potential duplicate CRM entities (Contacts, Leads, Accounts) based on various fields such as email, phone, name, and website. It includes methods for normalization and fuzzy matching, specifically tailored for a Django project with models for these entities.

classes.name: DuplicateDetector
classes.description: Service class providing static and class methods for detecting duplicate CRM entities based on multiple fields and normalization techniques.

methods.name: str normalize_phone(phone: str)
methods.description: Removes all non-digit characters from a phone number and returns the last 10 digits to standardize phone number comparison.

methods.name: str normalize_domain(website: str)
methods.description: Extracts and normalizes the domain from a website URL for comparison purposes.

methods.name: list["Contact"] find_duplicate_contacts( cls, org, email: str | None = None, phone: str | None = None, first_name: str | None = None, last_name: str | None = None, exclude_id=None, )
methods.description: Finds potential duplicate contacts based on email, normalized phone, and name matching within an organization.

methods.name: list["Lead"] find_duplicate_leads( cls, org, email: str | None = None, phone: str | None = None, first_name: str | None = None, last_name: str | None = None, company_name: str | None = None, exclude_id=None, )
methods.description: Finds potential duplicate leads based on email, normalized phone, name, and company name matching.

methods.name: list["Account"] find_duplicate_accounts( cls, org, name: str | None = None, email: str | None = None, website: str | None = None, phone: str | None = None, exclude_id=None, )
methods.description: Finds potential duplicate accounts based on name, email, website domain, and phone number.
